arabic text: KARBALA DI KHAAKH TAY KUSDA RAIYA SHABBIR\nZAINAB TAKDI RAYE
english translation text: Shabbir lay suffering upon the soil of Karbala,\nwhile Zainab could only watch.

arabic text: UMMAT NEH MAAR CHOOREYA BACHRA BATOOL DA\nBAYJURM TAY BAYTAK SEER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text: The community struck down Batul’s son—\ninnocent, helpless and bareheaded—while Zainab watched.

arabic text:
EH VEKH TAY VEER EDHA KOYI NA RAIYA
KALMA GO ZULAM KAMONDAY RAY
KOYI TAPTI HOWAY RAYT NU ZAKHMAAN TAY
PAHWAANDA
KOYI PATHAR MARAY KOYI TEER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text:
She saw that her brother had no one
left. Those who recited the creed
continued their cruelty. One pressed the
burning sand into his wounds; another hurled
stones, another arrows—while Zainab watched.

arabic text:
ASGHAR DI AMBRI MURR MURR KAY
PEENGAY DI DOR HALAANDI AY
KHAIMAY DAY DARR TAY AAN KAY VAHJAAN VI MAARDI
GAIYA PAANI PHEEN SAGHEER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text:
Asghar’s mother repeatedly
pulled the empty cradle’s cord.
Standing at the tent-door, she kept calling:
‘Drink some water, my infant’—while Zainab watched.

arabic text:
KADI HONSALA DAIVAY LAILA NU
KADI AAN RUBAB NU GAAL LAAVAY
KUJ VI NA KAAR SAAKI JADO UMMAT NEH KAAR
LAIYAAN
BHARJAIYAAN AAN ASEER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text:
At times she comforted Laila;
at times she embraced Rubab.
She could do nothing when the
community made her
sisters-in-law prisoners—while Zainab watched.

arabic text:
SIR NANGEYAAN VEKH KAY PHUPIYAAN NU
SAJAAD BAZAAR ICH RAT ROYA
ABID DI KANDH TAY ZULAM NU KEETAY LAYEEN NAY
ONA ZULMAAN DI TEHREER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text:
Seeing his aunts bareheaded,
Sajjad wept blood in the marketplace.
The accursed men wrote their cruelty upon Abid’s back—
while Zainab watched.

arabic text:
HAYE LADLI FAATEH-E-KHAIBAR DI
RAB JANAY KYUN MAJBOOR HOYI
MAKTAL JO TURR PAYI JADO GHAZI DE MAARN TAY
LOOTI JAD CHADAR TATHHEER ZAINAB TAKDI RAYE.
english translation text:
Alas, the beloved daughter of the Conqueror of Khaybar—
God knows why she was made so helpless.
When she left the battlefield after Ghazi’s martyrdom,
her veil of purity was plundered—while Zainab watched.
